conclusion: The ramdisk is a raw APFS container fully parseable at the block level on Windows. No macOS mount required. The existing apfs_snapshot_portable.cpp already implements fletcher64 APFS block checksum read/write. Remaining work: B-tree node walker (fixed+variable table space), omap oid->paddr resolution, catalog key lookup for /System/Library/LaunchDaemons, file extent write, and a Windows ad-hoc Mach-O cdhash signer.

ad-hoc codesign every arm64/arm64e binary (cdhash computation)
build trustcache (TrustCacheModule1 v1, entries = sorted 40-hex cdhashes, hashType=2)
re-seal APFS: fletcher64 block checksums must be recomputed after any metadata write
